confirmed.value: Assistant report/viewing alone is not teacher confirmation. Explicit teacher confirmation is scoped only to the unambiguous immediately referenced student/sections.
Original wrong clinic is not applicable for a 100-point preparation attempt; never treat that as overall teacher completion.
Always ask whether similar clinic was actually printed before declaring completion; 100 points does not answer this. Similar clinic assignment depends on the teacher each time.
Teacher may require additional similar clinic or review because of suspected false work or insufficient understanding. Do not infer suspicion or accusation from a score.
Even a perfect first paper grade requires a separate final teacher judgment after checking solution and understanding.
Students cannot re-enter answers in the app; they must approach their assigned teacher. Do not implement or interview hypothetical student resubmission-after-print workflows.
Track known question subsets independently; otherwise record partial completion with unknown membership. Whole-scope final completion requires explicit teacher confirmation for that scope.

Upload and teacher review are separate. Insufficient video remains reshoot or supplement needed. Detailed review rubric is deferred at user request, not invented or a blocker to recording explicit teacher decisions.
Paper learning and app answer-entry/grading record are independent. Teacher-finalized paper with no app grading record is learning complete / app record missing, not incomplete learning.
Writing alone is not completion. Teacher confirms explanation and understanding before final completion.

Mindmap is an optional one-page paper assigned by the teacher when needed. It is the final organization of what the student explained on the board or orally during the concept blank test. Map it to that exact activity and scope; do not create an independent mandatory assignment.
Reprinting the same paper preserves learning/grading history and adds print/distribution events. Carryover to the next lesson is the same assignment, not a new duplicate.
Only explicit teacher recheck instructions reopen a previously completed scope; preserve prior final judgment in history.
If a unit-complete statement has ambiguous activity coverage, ask for scope. Never complete unmentioned videos, DailyTest or clinics.

deferred.reason: User says too deep for now; remind later, no inferred rubric.
